explanation: arXiv:1605.05599 credits the case Δ1 = 2 of the conjecture to Aigner–Brandt (J. London Math. Soc. 48 (1993) 39–51). The formal statement takes Δ1 ≤ 2 plus the BEC inequality and concludes packing; the cases Δ1 ∈ {0, 1} are elementary (edgeless, matchings), so this is a correct known result. Minor: the docstring's reference key [AF93] for the Aigner–Brandt paper is mislabelled, which does not affect the statement. Faithful.
